name: Monkey's Great Escape
author: odrrey
description:
by Audrey Gracia Djohari
This is my school project

The monkey is tired of being cooped up in his cage, and he’s planning a great escape. As a monkey, the player must navigate through the different parts of the zoo and overcome various obstacles to reach the outside world. But be careful - the zookeepers are on high alert, and they'll do everything in their power to stop the monkey from escaping.

Keyboard Key:
Walk = Left & Right
Jump = Space bar
Throw Trash = Left Mouse Click (Fire1)
